description: This file defines internal classes and templates for string formatting and format specification binding within the Abseil C++ library, including classes for format specifiers, conversions, and formatting functions.

classes.name: BoundConversion
classes.description: Represents a bound format conversion specification, allowing access and modification of the associated argument.

classes.name: UntypedFormatSpecImpl
classes.description: Type-erased class representing a format specification, either as a string view or a parsed format object.

classes.name: FormatSpecTemplate
classes.description: Template class for format specifications, supporting compile-time format string validation and conversion.

classes.name: Streamable
classes.description: Wraps format specifications and arguments for streaming output.

classes.name: StreamedWrapper
classes.description: Wrapper for streaming an object via '%s' in format output.

methods.name: has_parsed_conversion
methods.description: Checks if the format spec has a parsed conversion.

methods.name: str
methods.description: Returns the string view of the format spec.

methods.name: Extract
methods.description: Extracts the format spec from a given object.

methods.name: CheckArity
methods.description: Checks if the number of arguments matches the format specifiers.

methods.name: CheckMatch
methods.description: Checks if a specific argument matches the expected format specifier.

methods.name: CheckMatches
methods.description: Checks all format specifiers against provided arguments.

methods.name: Print
methods.description: Outputs the formatted string to an ostream.

methods.name: Summarize
methods.description: Provides a summary string of the format and arguments.

methods.name: BindWithPack
methods.description: Binds a pack of arguments to a format property.

methods.name: FormatUntyped
methods.description: Formats arguments according to the specified format.

methods.name: AppendPack
methods.description: Appends formatted arguments to a string.

methods.name: FormatPack
methods.description: Formats a pack of arguments into a string.

methods.name: FprintF
methods.description: Prints formatted output to a FILE* stream.

methods.name: SnprintF
methods.description: Prints formatted output to a character buffer.

methods.name: StreamedWrapper
methods.description: Wraps a value for streaming output.
